name: switchboard
description: See your other Claude Code sessions at a glance: which one is waiting on you, which is working, which is done

dir.title: Shared folder
dir.description: Folder where every session leaves a small status file. Empty means ~/.claude/switchboard. Sessions that share a folder see each other.

showBand.title: Row above the prompt
showBand.description: Show one row above the prompt while another session is waiting on you. Off leaves only the /board pane.

minWaitSeconds.title: Wait before the row appears (seconds)
minWaitSeconds.description: A session must wait this long before it shows in the row, so a quick approval never flashes it.
